items.title: Time-space-head lower bounds for error-correcting-code encoders with sequential message access
items.author: Joshua Cook; Dana Moshkovitz
items.source_version: CCC2024, LIPIcs volume300 article5, 2024-07-15, official PDF pp.5:1-5:54; editable author-text transcription
items.difficulty_reason: The authors develop an interval-marking method that distinguishes repeatedly crossing a boundary from revisiting an interval after all heads have left. Adaptive encoders are handled by random restrictions and state-tuple collisions. The resulting sequential-access time-space-head lower bound is a nonroutine information argument; all supporting local proofs remain uncounted.
